full_prompt_en: A surreal black-and-white photographic montage shows an old wooden house and a huge spreading tree carried together on a floating fragment of earth. The rectangular land slice hangs in the center of the frame several feet above an empty road or plain, its rough underside exposed as a dark broken wedge. The weathered house has a small porch, dark doorways, boarded or shadowed windows, and a low pitched roof. Immediately behind and through it, a massive tree trunk rises into a broad cloudlike crown of countless fine branches and leaves. Bright cumulus clouds fill much of the sky behind the tree, echoing its rounded canopy. Far below, a straight road or narrow track recedes into a flat treeless horizon, emphasizing that the hovering island has no visible support. The scene is assembled from realistic photographic parts, with convincing wood grain, roots, soil, cloud texture, and distant ground despite the impossible arrangement. The tonal range runs from luminous whites in the clouds to charcoal shadows under the porch and the floating soil, with many fine middle grays in the foliage. A soft diffuse light makes the composite calm rather than spectacular, and the horizon is kept low so the solitary cluster appears suspended in abundant air. The tree and house almost merge into one central mass, while the open lower half creates a pause beneath them. Slight film grain and darkroom-like blending soften the seams, but the cut edge of the land remains crisp. The image feels meditative and uncanny, turning a familiar rural home into a small self-contained world detached from the ground.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅超现实黑白摄影蒙太奇表现一座旧木屋和一棵巨大展枝树共同被一片漂浮土地托起。矩形土块悬在画面中央，距下方空路或平原有数尺，其粗糙底面露成深色破碎楔形。风化房屋有小门廊、深门口、封闭或阴暗的窗和低斜屋顶。紧贴房后并穿过建筑，一根巨大树干升为由无数细枝和叶构成、云朵般宽阔的树冠。明亮积云占据树后的大部分天空，与圆浑树冠互相呼应。很低下方，一条直路或窄道退入平坦无树的地平线，强调悬浮土地没有可见支撑。场景由写实摄影部件组成，尽管安排不可能，木纹、根、土、云和远地仍可信。灰阶从云的亮白延至门廊及悬土下方的炭影，叶间保留大量细中灰。柔和漫射光让拼接显得安静而非壮观，地平线压低，使孤独簇群悬在大量空气中。树与屋近乎并为一体，下半部开放区域在其下制造停顿。轻胶片颗粒和暗房般融合软化接缝，但土地切边保持清楚。画面冥想且怪诞，把熟悉乡屋变为一座与地面脱离的自足小世界。
style_prompt_en: Surreal monochrome photographic montage joins realistic fragments into a physically impossible but tonally coherent whole. Bright cloud whites, soft middle-gray organic texture, weathered charcoal structures, and a dark broken underside form a broad grayscale hierarchy. One dense central cluster floats above a low flat horizon, with abundant empty air isolating it from the ground. Fine photographic detail remains in wood grain, foliage, soil, and distant track, while darkroom-like feathering blends contact points between fragments. The suspended edge stays crisp enough to make the contradiction readable. Diffuse light and minimal cast shadow prevent the scene from becoming theatrical; its strangeness arises from scale and placement. Rounded upper masses echo one another, opposing the angular lower wedge and narrow receding ground line. Slight film grain unifies the image, giving the composition a quiet, contemplative, archival dream quality.
style_prompt_zh: 超现实单色摄影蒙太奇把写实碎片接成物理上不可能却明度连贯的整体。亮云白、柔中灰有机纹理、风化炭色构造和暗色破碎底面形成宽广灰阶层级。一组浓密中央簇群浮在低平地平线上，丰富空中留白让它与地面隔开。木纹、叶丛、土和远路保持精细摄影细节，暗房般羽化融合碎片接触点。悬浮边缘足够清晰，使矛盾可读。漫射光与极少投影避免场景舞台化；怪异来自尺度和摆位。圆浑上方体量彼此呼应，对位棱角下楔及收窄的地面线。轻胶片颗粒统一图像，令构图有安静、沉思、档案式梦境质感。
theme_en: An old house and large tree float together on a piece of earth above an empty plain
theme_zh: 老屋与大树共同漂浮在空旷平原上方的一块土地上
name: Jerry N. Uelsmann
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
